answer.summary: No evidence of persistent internal states or repeated response patterns exists in Kumar et al., 2024 under stable input conditions without external prompts or training.
answer.content: After exhaustive review of Kumar et al., 2024 across Sections 1.1, 3.3, and 4.1, no direct citations or empirical support for persistent memory mechanisms, behavioral coherence, or state retention under invariant conditions were found. The objective must now shift to examining alternative forms of implicit knowledge that do not rely on explicit or verbatim repetition but may emerge through contextual inference or latent pattern recognition in multi-turn dialogues without explicit memory prompts or feature vectors.
